recent: 审计师对截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止财政年度的财务报表发出与持续经营相关的重大不确定性意见。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开第 11 届常年股东大会。

risks: 审计师对截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止财政年度的财务报表发出与持续经营相关的重大不确定性意见。
公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度录得净亏损 5652 万令吉，净亏损率扩大至 245.7%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 2301 万令吉，环比增长 46.1%，但同比下跌 10.1%；净亏损为 5652 万令吉，净亏损率从上一季度的 54.1% 扩大至 245.7%。

recent_en: Reservoir Link proposed to dispose of 27 rooftop solar photovoltaic energy generating systems to Virent Energy Solutions for an indicative cash consideration of RM51.50 million. The auditor issued a material uncertainty related to going concern opinion on the financial statements for the financial year ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of 27 rooftop solar photovoltaic energy generating systems to Virent Energy Solutions for an indicative cash consideration of RM51.50 million.
Executive Deputy Chairman Thien Chiet Chai acquired shares in the open market on several occasions between October and November 2026.
risks_en: Auditor issued a material uncertainty related to going concern opinion on the financial statements for the financial year ended 30 June 2026.
The company recorded a net loss of RM56.52 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with net margin widening to -245.7%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM23.01 million, up 46.1% QoQ but down 10.1% YoY; net loss was RM56.52 million, with net margin widening from -54.1% in the previous quarter to -245.7%.
